title: Like imagine getting to see Pheobe Waller-Bridge perform Fleabag befo...
transcript: This show is being adapted for Netflix, which means you have the opportunity to see it now before it wins all of the Emmys in two years. It is from the same producers as Flea Bag and Baby Reindeer, both of which also made the jump from stage to limited series, and so it is obviously trying to follow in those same footsteps. But I do think it stands on its own. The show is about climate change, and it kind of captures that feeling of the world is burning around you and no one else really cares. And I think that, as a topic could easily be preachy or boring, but definitely not in this play. It is only 70 minutes, and it is completely gripping from start to finish. Our main character, Stacy, the titular weather girl, is played by Julia McDermott, and she is giving an absolutely unreal performance in the show. Like, the number one reason to see this is not even that it's being adapted for Netflix, but rather it's Julia's performance. I think she is such a star. She has a very bright career ahead of her, and I'm calling it right now because she is starring in the Netflix version. I think she's gonna win the Emmy for this, and her career is about to just skyrocket. Unfortunately, it is only running through October 12th, and I believe the rest of the run is sold out. But if you somehow can get a ticket, Or if they end up doing another run of this, I highly recommend getting a ticket. And then you can brag to all of your friends that you saw it before it was on Netflix.
